messages:
Maria: Hey folks — thinking about adding an "Explain quota" affordance in Console for routes. idea: small tooltip / flyout that shows how tokens map to quota buckets + why some requests consume more (batching, embeddings). need input on what the API/SDK surface should be for this and how to roll it out safely.
Ajay: +1. We need backend support: a per-request `quota_breakdown` snapshot from the policy engine. Console can pull that for a route and show examples. question: do we want SDKs to expose that info automatically or keep it Console-only behind an admin flag?
Kate: Product preference: surface in Console first (admin & billing teams). SDK exposure should be opt-in to avoid leaking internal accounting to customers. UX: tooltip should show concise bullets and an example request -> cost mapping.
Nora: From SDK POV, we could add an opt-in flag `quota_explainability: true` on client config which, when enabled, sends `X-RD-Quota-Explain: 1` header and parses a `quota_breakdown` section on responses. default: off. backwards compat: header ignored by older servers — safe.
Samuel: Console ideally fetches route-level examples from an endpoint instead of per-user requests. We can store precomputed examples for routes (cached) so we don't hit runtime. For live debugging, allow a "Show sample request" that hits API with explain header — restricted by role.
Ajay: Implementation notes: add optional field to response envelope `quota_breakdown` JSON blob. example shape (sketch):
```
quota_breakdown: {
  "units": [
    {"name":"token_generation","tokens":42,"bucket":"hosted:tokens"},
    {"name":"embedding_lookup","tokens":128,"bucket":"embeds:units"}
  ],
  "total_units":170
}
```
This will be added only when `X-RD-Quota-Explain: 1` is present or when route-level admin preview is enabled.
Maria: Sounds good. Rollout plan thought: console-first behind FF `quota_explainability_ui`. Beta to 10% orgs, then 50%. SDK opt-in flag can be documented in the same beta notes. Need telemetry for adoption and confusion signals.
Kate: Telemetry we want: API calls with explain header, console clicks on tooltip, and "disputed" button when users say the breakdown looks wrong. Also track if showing breakdown increases support tickets.
Ajay: Telemetry/events to add: - `quota.explain.requested` (with route_id, org_id, sdk_language) - `quota.explain.shown` (ui) - `quota.explain.disputed`. Make sure pii-free: route_id ok, redact api keys.
Nora: Question: how should languages expose the parsed object? JS/py: return an extra field on response object `.quota_breakdown` when present. We should name it `.meta.quota_breakdown` to avoid collisions. Also add helper `client.getQuotaExamples(routeId)` in SDKs that calls internal admin endpoint (requires token scope).
Samuel: We'll prefer examples precomputed by backend admin endpoint. Console call will be like `GET /v1/routes/{id}/quota_examples?preview=true` which will return sanitized examples; preview only for org admins.
ci-bot: deploy pipeline: canary tag created for `quota-explain` backend feature flag. CI stage ok: build passed, integration tests flagged `--quota-explain` run.
Ajay: Compatibility constraints: do NOT include `quota_breakdown` by default for client-facing production endpoints. Only when header present or admin preview enabled. Also add rate limit for explanation requests (cheap but still added load).
Maria: Docs sprint: I'll draft the Console copy + SDK opt-in docs. Nora — can you sketch the Python/TS API surface this week? timeline: 2-week beta.
Nora: Yep. Sketch for Python:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., quota_explainability=False)  # default
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., quota_explainability=True)  # opt-in
resp = c.generate("...")
print(resp.meta.quota_breakdown)
```
For TS similar: `new Redwood({apiKey, quotaExplainability: true})`.
Ajay: I'll add the response field to the response envelope in the API spec and a new header `X-RD-Quota-Explain` (0/1). Also add a capability flag in org settings `quota_explainability_enabled` for Console to flip per-org.
Kate: Approvals: need legal review if we show per-customer cost breakdowns (billing ops), and privacy review for telemetry. I'll loop in legal and privacy.
Maria: Thanks. Action items: - ajay: API spec PR with header + response shape (due EOW) - nora: SDK PRs with opt-in flag + parser (draft by Thu) - samuel: Console mockups + FF gating plan (proto by next Tues) - kate: run legal/privacy checks and list required text (by next Wed) I'll track on the Feature board.
Ajay: noted. I'll add rate-limit header sample in PR and initial schema. Also adding `quota.explain.requested` telemetry.
Nora: One more: for embedders using streaming, explainability may affect streaming envelope. We'll emit `quota_breakdown` only at final response chunk or as separate `meta` event to avoid fragmenting stream.
Maria: Good catch. OK team — slack thread wrap up: can we all react with :white_check_mark: when started on tasks? Thanks!
Samuel: ✅ starting mocks
Nora: ✅ will open draft PR
Ajay: ✅ spec PR in progress
Kate: ✅ legal pinged
